about.title: About the brand
about.storyIntro: For me, 19:38 is a special time. I started noticing it again and again, in moments when something in my life was about to happen.
about.paragraph1: 19:38 is not just a time. It’s the moment you stop and notice a sign. Someone remembers you. Someone writes. Something ends. Something begins. You meet the right person. Or you simply understand something you didn’t before.
about.paragraph2: A 19:38 piece becomes the same kind of personal sign. You don’t just choose it. You notice it.
about.quote1: Some call it angel time. We call it a sign.
about.quote1Ru: Some call it angel time. We call it a sign.
about.cardTitle: Every piece comes with a card
about.cardBody: Front of the card: “19:38 — You noticed it.” Back: “Some moments feel like coincidence. Some feel like a message. Keep the ones that mean something to you.”
about.oneOfOneBody: Every piece carries a number — like “19:38 / 007” — and the note “This piece exists only once.” It turns the jewelry into a near-collectible object.
about.moodBody: A bordeaux bar, silver, pearls, red lipstick, vinyl records, an old phone, notes, mirrors, leather, silk, old photographs, camera flash, watches, natural stones.

shipping.title: Shipping & Payment
shipping.shippingBody: We ship worldwide. Delivery time and cost depend on your country and whether the piece is in stock or made to order — we’ll confirm the details individually once you submit a request.
shipping.paymentBody: At this stage, payment is arranged after your order is confirmed by our team, in whichever way is convenient for you. Online payment on the site is coming soon.
shipping.productionBody: Some pieces are already in stock and ship within a few days. Made-to-order and personalized pieces (engraving, size, color) are produced individually — timing is discussed when you submit your request.

items.a: We use natural stones, rhodium, and pearl. Materials for each piece are listed on its product page.

items.q: What does the number on the product card mean?
items.a: Every piece gets its own number (for example, “19:38 / 007”) and exists in a single copy — it’s part of the personal-sign idea.

items.q: Can I get an engraving or change the size?
items.a: Yes, personalization is available for some pieces: engraving, size, color. Let us know when you submit your request and we’ll work out the details.

items.q: How do I place an order?
items.a: Add pieces to your cart and submit a request. We’ll contact you to confirm the order and discuss production, shipping, and payment.
Yes, we ship worldwide. Shipping cost and timing are confirmed individually.
Yes, return conditions are described on the Returns page.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This section describes how 19:38 Jewelry collects and uses customers’ personal data. Replace this text with a legally reviewed policy before the public launch.
privacy.section1Body: Name, contact details (phone, e-mail, messenger), shipping address, and the content of your order request.
privacy.section2Body: Data is used solely to process your order, communicate with you, and improve our service. We do not share data with third parties except where required to deliver your order.
privacy.section3Body: Data is kept for as long as necessary to fulfill your order and meet legal requirements.

returns.title: Returns
returns.intro: Draft terms — review and adjust before publishing.
returns.section1Body: Items in good condition that were not made to a personal order can be returned within 14 days of receipt, provided they keep their original condition and packaging.
returns.section2Body: Pieces made to a personal order (engraving, altered size) cannot be returned or exchanged, except in the case of a manufacturing defect.
returns.section3Body: Contact us via the Contact page with your order number and the reason for the return — we’ll guide you through the next steps.
